YOUR EMPIRE
Drag, pinch and zoom across the whole atlas. Sea stays blue; unexplored land is dark but readable; every town you liberate awakens in light green with its sanctuary icon.
The whole world remains visible beneath the veil. Travel to a real town, win its Liberation Battle and build a birdhouse; that sanctuary will wake in light green with its own icon.
